source: NDMA Disaster Guidelines & Bioclimatic Extreme Weather Adaptation Standards

heatwave.title: Daytime Glazing Shielding
heatwave.advice: Keep external shutters and reflective curtains fully drawn between 10:00 AM and 5:00 PM.
heatwave.reason: Prevents direct infrared radiation from penetrating interior spaces during peak solar exposure hours.

heatwave.title: Evaporative Cooling Enhancement
heatwave.advice: Sprinkle terrace slabs or courtyard floors with water during late evening.
heatwave.reason: Evaporative heat absorption draws stored sensible heat out of masonry surfaces before nightfall.

heatwave.title: Nocturnal Cross-Draft Activation
heatwave.advice: Open high and low opposing vents once outdoor air drops below indoor temperature (typically after 9:00 PM).
heatwave.reason: Flushes trapped hot air from ceiling zones and recharges wall thermal mass with cooler night air.

cold_wave.title: Draft Elimination & Airlocks
cold_wave.advice: Install door sweeps, seal window frame gaskets, and keep entry vestibule doors closed.
cold_wave.reason: Infiltration of freezing wind through hairline gaps can account for up to 40% of room heating loss.

cold_wave.title: Nocturnal Insulated Drapes
cold_wave.advice: Close heavy thermal curtains or insulated shutters immediately as the sun sets.
cold_wave.reason: Creates a protective still-air boundary layer that cuts radiant heat transfer through window glass.

cold_wave.title: Daytime Solar Harvesting
cold_wave.advice: Open South-facing curtains completely during sunlit midday hours.
cold_wave.reason: Permits maximum passive solar radiation to warm interior mass floors and walls directly.

heavy_rain.title: Roof & Plinth Runoff Clearance
heavy_rain.advice: Inspect rainwater downspouts, roof valley gutters, and plinth apron trenches before peak precipitation.
heavy_rain.reason: Prevents stormwater pooling near foundation footings and eliminates hydrostatic wall dampness.

heavy_rain.title: Louvered Wet-Weather Aeration
heavy_rain.advice: Maintain air exchanges through protected louvered vents under wide roof eaves while keeping main window sashes shut.
heavy_rain.reason: Avoids stagnant indoor moisture accumulation and mold growth without admitting wind-blown rain.

heavy_rain.title: Plinth Protection & Flood Barriers
heavy_rain.advice: Deploy temporary flood barriers or sandbags at low threshold entrances if ground water levels rise.
heavy_rain.reason: Guards against surface water ingress during flash runoff events.
